description: Fixture stories with known-good expectations for scripts/evaluate.py. Fictional events and people.

stories.title: Arsenal beat Chelsea 2-1 in tense London derby
stories.summary: Arsenal came from behind to beat Chelsea 2-1 at the Emirates. Midfielder Tomas Reyes equalised before half-time and striker Leo Hartmann headed the winner in the 78th minute, lifting Arsenal to second in the Premier League.

stories.title: Liverpool held to goalless draw by Everton
stories.summary: Liverpool were held to a 0-0 draw by Everton at Anfield. Everton goalkeeper Sam Okafor made seven saves as the visitors frustrated the Premier League leaders, who had 24 shots.

stories.title: Tottenham boss sacked after 3-0 defeat at Brentford
stories.summary: Tottenham have sacked head coach Marco Lindqvist after a 3-0 defeat at Brentford left the club 14th in the Premier League. Fans were furious after a sixth defeat in nine games.

stories.title: Newcastle in talks to sign Dortmund winger Felix Amari
stories.summary: Newcastle are in talks with Borussia Dortmund over a January transfer for winger Felix Amari. The 23-year-old has scored six goals this season and Newcastle are weighing a fee of around 40 million euros.

stories.title: Aston Villa captain ruled out for six weeks with hamstring injury
stories.summary: Aston Villa captain Dan Mercer has been ruled out for six weeks with a hamstring injury suffered against Fulham. Villa will be without their captain for the busy December schedule.

stories.title: VAR row as Brighton denied late penalty against West Ham
stories.summary: Brighton were furious after VAR declined to award a late penalty in their 1-1 draw with West Ham. Manager Oscar Feld said the decision was a disgrace.

stories.title: Manchester City thrash Wolves 4-0
stories.summary: Manchester City thrashed Wolves 4-0 at the Etihad. Forward Kai Brandt scored twice and City have now won four Premier League games in a row.

stories.title: Real Madrid stunned 2-0 by Sevilla in La Liga upset
stories.summary: Real Madrid suffered a shock 2-0 defeat away at Sevilla. Striker Ivan Molero scored both goals as Real Madrid dropped to third, two points behind Barcelona.

stories.title: Celtic beat Rangers 3-1 to extend Scottish Premiership lead
stories.summary: Celtic beat Rangers 3-1 at Celtic Park to move five points clear at the top of the Scottish Premiership. Winger Ross Callan scored twice in a dominant second-half display.

stories.title: Inter Milan agree contract extension with Paolo Ricci
stories.summary: Inter Milan have agreed a contract extension with centre-back Paolo Ricci until 2030. The 27-year-old has made 140 Serie A appearances.
